ownership: one primary mailbox per authenticated tenant/UID; no client supplied target UID

routes.GET status: current owner status and allowed provider policy
routes.POST connect: owner credential over HTTPS; strict POP TLS AUTH+UIDL ACK then encrypted persistence
routes.POST sync: bounded live UIDL scan, durable cursor, provider presence and idempotent message import
routes.GET messages: owner cached headers with last observed state and pagination
routes.GET messages/{id}: provider UIDL lookup of current message number, bounded MIME body; archived copy visibly marked if absent upstream
routes.POST disconnect: delete local encrypted credential and fence old requests; no remote account/mail deletion
routes.POST send: explicit owner action; immutable idempotent intent, server-owned sender, durable pre-DATA journal and positive SMTP DATA ACK
routes.POST reply: same send contract plus original message from same owner/account; server-owned Reply-To/From recipient, In-Reply-To and bounded References
routes.GET outbox: latest 50 owner submission records with durable human states; does not send or import Outlook Sent
routes.GET outbox/{id}: current owner submission detail/ACK; expired post-DATA operation becomes delivery_unknown

security.tls: implicit TLS1.2+ with system certificate trust and SNI; exact host allowlist and public DNS only
security.secrets: AES-256-GCM with AAD tenant+uid+account; root key only Secret Manager-mounted server environment
security.directBrowserFirestoreAccess: default deny by existing rules; API only
security.authorization: Firebase verifyIdToken(checkRevoked=true), exact tenant/UID and active durable membership/claims each request
security.receiptPrivacy: no password, token, raw provider response or mailbox body in QA logs

sync.identity: UIDL unique ID plus mailbox account key; never POP sequence number
sync.concurrency: server lease + generation fencing; UIDL create-if-absent in Firestore transaction

activationRequirements: strict no-credential TLS POP995/SMTP465 probe PASS for actual host
CXORBIA_MAILBOX_CREDENTIAL_KEY_B64 mounted from a dedicated Secret Manager version: exactly32bytes base64
each user POP credential supplied only to authenticated HTTPS own-mailbox connect; account password is not Firebase password
authenticated receive ACK/session/reload/second-owner-negative evidence on exact materialized artifact
CXORBIA_USER_MAILBOX_SEND_ENABLED=true through canonical runtime config only when SMTP activation is approved
set provider.sendEnabled=true only for the scoped provider after approved activation; source-safe policy remains false in this proposal
service runtime identity has secretAccessor only on the mailbox root-key secret/version; secret value must not enter build/source/browser/logs
authenticated SMTP send/reply ACK250 + durable outbox reload + second-owner negative + lost-ACK duplicate guard evidence on exact certified artifact; no real send performed by this proposal
neverInfer: local Outlook Sent/archive folders from POP inbox
TLS socket success as authenticated mailbox connection
another project backend/credential as transferable authorization
in-app HR alert as external mail delivery
SMTP DATA ACK250 as recipient delivery or read confirmation
missing HTTP or SMTP ACK as not sent
same Message-ID as provider-side deduplication guarantee
source implementation or offline fixture PASS as activated/certified provider sending

smtp.transport: existing connectStrictTls; port465 implicit TLS1.2+ only; authenticated EHLO-advertised PLAIN or LOGIN; no external SMTP dependency
smtp.from: connected account address and same encrypted POP credential; tenant and UID solely from verified principal
smtp.request: send: idempotencyKey/to/subject/text; reply: idempotencyKey/parentId/text; other fields denied

limits.recipientEncoding: ASCII addr-spec; no display names or SMTPUTF8

smtp.content: text/plain UTF-8 base64 MIME; encoded subject; strict CRLF/header rejection; no attachments or HTML send
smtp.idempotency: immutable request digest under owner/account, transactional create-once, deterministic Message-ID; same key never resubmits; unresolved identical content also blocked under a new key
smtp.stateBoundary: persist data_in_flight before first body byte; loss after DATA without positive250 or explicit final rejection is delivery_unknown; accepted means provider accepted, not delivered/read
smtp.crashRecovery: expired prepared becomes not_sent; expired data_in_flight becomes delivery_unknown; journal write failure after positive SMTP ACK never becomes not_sent
smtp.allRecipients: no DATA if any RCPT is rejected; no partial recipient submission
smtp.reconcileUnknown: read durable outbox; investigate provider receipt/Message-ID before another intent; no automatic replay to SMTP
smtp.defaultActivation: both feature flags plus provider sendEnabled=true are required for a new submission; proposal leaves send disabled
